_README: Copy this file to app.local.json (gitignored) before building locally.
app.config.js merges it into expo.extra, overriding app.json.
Resolution order: EAS env var > app.local.json > app.json.
Every key here is OPTIONAL - the app builds and runs without this file,
with push, email and remote logging degrading to a silent no-op.
Keys prefixed with _ are ignored at runtime and exist only as documentation.
_notifyUrl: Cloudflare Worker that sends push + email. EAS env var: NOTIFY_URL
_newRelicKey: New Relic INGEST-LICENSE key (NOT a user key): one.newrelic.com > user menu > API keys > type 'INGEST - LICENSE'. Absent = logs stay on-device.
_newRelicRegion: 'us' (default) or 'eu' - must match your New Relic account data region, or ingest silently 403s.
